shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "theme" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -40; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup Switch useThemeValue
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup useTheme Text; grep -n "version" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -2

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && rg -n -i -C3 "theme|required setup" README.md | head -80; ls build/esm/components/theme/ build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/ 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && rg -n -A20 "interface ControlGroupProps" types.d.ts; rg -n -A8 "interface ControlGroupOption" types.d.ts; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; rg -n "variant" Text/Text.d.ts; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS|'header-|'subheader-|'body-" text/*.d.ts ../../../build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "export" index.d.ts | rg -i "flex|text|segmented|theme"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS =" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/; rg -n "gap|direction|alignItems" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head
sed -i 's/<Flex direction="column" gap={4}/<Flex direction="column" alignItems="flex-start" gap={4}/' src/App.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit && echo OK
